newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Amara Holdings to list on Singapore's SESDAQ.
newsitem.headline: Amara Holdings to list on Singapore's SESDAQ.

text.p: Amara Holdings Pte Ltd said on Thursday it has received approval to list on the Stock Exchange of Singapore's second board, SESDAQ.
The group, which has investments in hotel, property, restaurants and food services, said in a statement the funds raised would be used to expand operations in Singapore and the region.
Apart from a hotel each in Vietnam's Ho Chi Minh City and Singapore, the group plans to open two more in China -- one in Chengdu in 1998 and one in Shanghai by 2000, the statement said.
It plans to add new rooms to its flagship hotel, Amara Singapore, and is developing a 12-storey office tower for capital investments and to enhance rental income.

Turnover for the group in fiscal year 1996 was Singapore $31 million while pre-tax profit was S$9.9 million. Revalued net tangible assets more than doubled to S$285 million in 1996 from S$125 million in 1992.
